name: SDN Data Retrieval Flow
description: HTTP data-retrieval flow (loop C.3c): a $HTQ HttpRequest enters on the http-request trigger, foundation/http-route emits the routing-decision JSON, foundation/decision-gate dispatches it to data-source/retrieval omm_bulk or data_query as an SDS $CAQ request (or straight to http-respond for 404s), the retrieval stream joins the decision in the gate's format branch (flatbuffer: verbatim to the response body; json: through foundation/omm-json encode) together with a deterministic FNV-1a etag, and foundation/http-respond assembles the final $HTR envelope (200/304/404) delivered to the host-model egress sink. All inter-node frames stay inside the linked-direct artifact's linear memory; engineLinkage: flatsql (loop C.7) — the retrieval node submits queries DIRECTLY to the live store engine via wasm imports (modules flatsql/flatsql_link); no storage.flatsql_* hostcalls exist on this path. Flatbuffer-branch bodies stay in engine memory as SDNE body-ref tokens; the json branch copies bytes engine->flow in-wasm.

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: Record retrieval served by the data-retrieval flow (wasm; all routing, param parsing, format selection and ETag logic run inside the module).

routes.summary: Per-object OMM catalog stream (epoch profile query)
routes.description: Returns one OMM record per object (NORAD_CAT_ID) selected by the requested epoch profile (default: nearest to now), as an aligned size-prefixed $OMM FlatBuffer stream (default) or a bare JSON array (format=json). Conditional GET is supported via ETag / If-None-Match. SCHEDULED FOR DELETION in loop G.6: superseded by the provider-scoped route /api/v1/peers/{peerId}/{standard}/latest.

params.name: epoch
params.description: Target epoch: RFC3339 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) or unix seconds. Default: now.

params.name: profile
params.description: Epoch selection profile (alias: mode; profile wins when both are present). Default: the retrieval module's configured per-standard profile (OMM: nearest).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records returned. Default: unbounded (catalog-sized).

params.name: source
params.description: Restrict to one registered provider source (e.g. celestrak-gp). Default: all sources, provider-latest batch.

params.name: format
params.description: Response encoding: flatbuffer = aligned size-prefixed FlatBuffer stream (default), json = bare JSON array of records.

200.description: Record stream. Metadata rides in headers on BOTH encodings: X-SDN-Record-Count and a content-derived ETag.

application/vnd.sdn.flatbuffers.stream.description: Aligned size-prefixed $OMM FlatBuffer frames ([u32le length][bytes], 8-byte aligned).

application/json.description: Bare top-level JSON array of OMM records (format=json). No envelope; record count and ETag are response headers.

304.description: Not modified (If-None-Match matched the stream ETag). Empty body, ETag header repeated.

404.description: No route matched under the mount.

routes.summary: FlatSQL query over the record store (flow route)
routes.description: Executes a FlatSQL query and streams the result verbatim as aligned FlatBuffer frames (or a bare JSON array with format=json). Body: JSON {"sql": "...", "params": [...]} or raw SQL text. NOTE: on current hosts the exact path /api/v1/data/query is shadowed by a native auth-gated route (Go mux exact-match precedence); this flow route answers any other path ending in /query under the mount. Superseded by the sandboxed public /api/v1/query (loop G.5).

200.description: Query result stream; X-SDN-Record-Count and ETag headers on both encodings.

application/vnd.sdn.flatbuffers.stream.description: Aligned size-prefixed FlatBuffer frames (all selected cells must be BLOB columns).

404.description: Missing/empty SQL body or no route matched.
